premises.text: Gift cards are lost, stolen, or forgotten, creating large unspent balances bad for consumers and retailers
premises.evidence_span: $20 billion in unspent gift cards every year? And that's because your gift cards end up lost, stolen, or forgotten

premises.text: App uploads plastic cards to a cloud-backed phone wallet with balance verification and barcode or scratch redemption
premises.evidence_span: Uploading a card to GIFT is simple

premises.text: Users buy and send personalized gift cards via Facebook, email, or text with merchant suggestions and event notifications
premises.evidence_span: seamlessly integrated with Facebook for convenience around sending gift cards to friends and family

premises.text: Recipients on any phone type can open and use cards; unwanted cards can be regifted
premises.evidence_span: we're unveiling a special feature today where you can regift unwanted cards to your friends

premises.text: National retail partners plus future open APIs let retailers and developers build on the wallet
premises.evidence_span: enabling both retailers and developers to leverage our open APIs and build on top of our platform

value.text: Simplify gift-card life by managing, sending, receiving, and redeeming from a phone
value.evidence_span: GIFT is here to simplify your life

secondary_value.text: Make gift cards fun and social
secondary_value.evidence_span: We're making gift cards fun, and we're making gift cards social

causal_links.evidence_span: manage all your gift card needs right from your mobile phone

notes: Independent run: partners and open APIs one distribution premise. Funding and giveaways excluded. Personalization engine inside send flow.
